evaluation_note: 2024/25 was previously inspected. The fixed 2025/26 study was declared before inspecting its model results; it becomes inspected after this run.
candidate_pool: Fixed union of heuristic-v1 and full decision-v11 top K, selected without labels; identical for every ablation

variants.without-team-strengths: Neutral team attack and defence; retain venue baselines, player rates and minutes
variants.without-xg-xa: Remove season and recent xG/xA fields; retain positional priors and all other components
variants.season-attacking-rates: Remove recent xG/xA only; retain shrunk season rates and recent minutes
variants.season-minutes: Use season-usage minutes fallback; retain recent attacking and event histories and common availability inputs
variants.half-history-fallback: Withhold histories for a deterministic season/player hash cohort of approximately half the pool; retain season inputs and availability
variants.all-history-fallback: Withhold all recent histories; retain season xG/xA, season usage and availability

comparisons: Paired differences against both heuristic-v1 and full decision-v11. Positive error differences mean worse; positive realised decision differences mean better. Ablations are exploratory with marginal intervals, not multiple-testing-adjusted claims.
fitting: None: no coefficients or thresholds fitted, selected or promoted using these results
limitations: Historical reconstructions use deadline, fixture and availability proxies
Conditional missing-history stress tests retain shared availability information
Single-next-GW validation cannot validate horizon decay or transfer-route value
Historical evidence cannot satisfy the existing live promotion policy
